name: e2e
description: Test AOI: the 41-reach test network, two lakes, no coast. Its flow statistics are limited to eight reaches, so only those are authored while the loop still sees the whole network; tests/test_e2e_aoi.py says why each one is there. q_bound_factors keeps the run short. Local paths are relative to this file; the land cover and lookup are staged to source_data/e2e/ by `just test-e2e`.
